about.main_academic_focus: The college primarily focuses on engineering, computer science, artificial intelligence, information technology, electronics, emerging technologies, and other science and technology disciplines.

milestones.event: GenZ Institute of Science and Technology was established.
New engineering and technology programs were introduced.
Advanced computer and technology laboratories were developed.
Industry-oriented training and innovation programs were expanded.

college_information.vision: To become a leading institution in science and technology by nurturing innovative, skilled, ethical, and socially responsible professionals.
